changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ItemStep') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[ItemStep]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ItemID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [StepID] [int] NOT NULL, [Settings] [xml] NULL, [Fields] [xml] NULL, [StartedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [StartedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CompletedBy] [int] NULL, [CompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, [ResourceObject] [varchar](50) NULL, [ResourceObjectID] [int] NULL, [UID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_workflow_ItemStep_UID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowItemStep] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItemStep_WorkflowItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStep] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStep_WorkflowItem] FOREIGN KEY([ItemID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[Item] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStep] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStep_WorkflowItem] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItemStep_WorkflowVersionStep') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStep] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStep_WorkflowVersionStep] FOREIGN KEY([StepID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[VersionStep] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStep] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStep_WorkflowVersionStep] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ItemStep_CompletedOn') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ItemStep_CompletedOn] ON [workflow].[ItemStep] ( [CompletedOn] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.xml_indexes where name = 'PXML_WorkflowItemStep_Fields') BEGIN CREATE PRIMARY XML INDEX [PXML_WorkflowItemStep_Fields] ON [workflow].[ItemStep] ( [Fields] ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ItemStep_ItemIDStepID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ItemStep_ItemIDStepID ON [workflow].[ItemStep] ([ItemID],[StepID]) END
